Yes—the complete save flow now works:

- Paste a URL and Keepr attempts to fetch its page title and description automatically.
- You can edit the fetched details before saving.
- The bookmark appears immediately at the top of the library.
- It persists after refreshing or reopening the app.

I demonstrated this with `https://www.nasa.gov/`:

- [See the automatic metadata lookup](</work/prototypes/add-bookmark-metadata.png>)
- [See NASA saved in the library](</work/prototypes/bookmark-save-result.png>)

I also reloaded the app and verified all seven bookmarks remained. Try it at [http://maker:4000](http://maker:4000).
